name: hyrule_castle
label: Hyrule Castle
about: Pieces and textures cut from Hyrule Castle (spot15). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09). `ground` is the hill's grass (a plain camo stretched huge, about 3400 a repeat), `path` the pale road up the hill (grass at its edges), `cliff` and `cliff_b` the rock walls of the road's cutting (grass lips top and bottom), `brick` the white castle walls and towers (cut out at the battlements), `battlement` and `battlement_b` their tops, `roof_green` the slate spires, `paving` and `paving_b` the bridge and ledges, `stone_*` the moat's stonework, `railing` the green iron railings along the moat. `gate_door`, `dark` and `window_grate` dress the closed castle gate; `statue_*` is the stone bird on the bridge over the road; `backdrop_*` are the far cards; `plain`, `plain_b` and `underside` have no texture.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: hc_moat_bridge
pieces.label: Castle moat bridge
pieces.about: The stone bridge over the castle moat: steps up 110 from the road, then a deck 190 wide and 300 long to the wall, two posts with green finials at its head. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: hc_castle_gate
pieces.label: Castle gate (closed)
pieces.about: The castle's front gate: barred doors in a dark recess between two buttresses, a pediment over them and a green lantern on each buttress. It never opens: set it on a wall's face. Locked.

pieces.name: hc_drain
pieces.label: Moat drain (crawlspace exit)
pieces.about: The drain in the castle's moat wall that Link crawls through into the courtyard (exit 2, ENTR_HAIRAL_NIWA_0): a hole 32 wide and 24 high (wall type crawl) with water spilling from it down the wall. The origin is the hole's foot on the wall's face. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: hc_stone_steps
pieces.label: Stone steps
pieces.about: Three stone blocks stepping up 90 out of the moat below the drain. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: hc_tower
pieces.label: Wall tower
pieces.about: A round white tower 740 tall with battlements, standing at a corner of the castle's outer wall (its back, inside the wall, is open).

pieces.name: hc_vines
pieces.label: Climbing vines
pieces.about: Vines 360 tall up the side of the road's cutting; Link can climb the middle strand (wall type vines).

pieces.name: hc_ladder
pieces.label: Ladder
pieces.about: A wooden ladder 330 tall up the side of the road's cutting (wall types ladder and ladder_top). Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: hc_bird_statue
pieces.label: Stone bird
pieces.about: A small stone bird with spread wings, perched above the road. No collision.

pieces.name: hc_flowers
pieces.label: Yellow flowers
pieces.about: A clump of yellow flowers (three cut-out cards) from the hill's grass. No collision.

pieces.name: hc_flowers_orange
pieces.label: Orange flowers
pieces.about: A clump of orange flowers (three cut-out cards) from the hill's grass. No collision.
